merged_body: miri EXECUTED (qwyti.22, 2026-07-25) on the sole pure-Rust unsafe block: 'cargo +nightly miri test --manifest-path native/angr/Cargo.toml --features fuzzer hitmap_raw_pointer' => icicle::tests::hitmap_raw_pointer_aliases_the_slice PASSES clean under miri (9.13s, no UB, no warnings) — provenance+aliasing of 'unsafe{*ptr.add(3)=0xAB}' via Hitmap::as_mut_ptr() into Pin<Box<[u8]>> is sound. Setup: nightly toolchain + cargo-miri already present; only 'rustup +nightly component add miri' + one-time sysroot build (~39s) needed. DECISION: NO nightly CI miri lane (single block, already covered by passing #[test]; other 70 unsafe sites cross a C ABI miri can't run). Feasibility spike that established this (qwyti.8): of 71 unsafe sites across 21 files, exactly ONE is pure-Rust/miri-executable — the hitmap_raw_pointer_aliases_the_slice site above, behind #[cfg(feature=fuzzer)]. All 70 others bottom out in a Z3 (from_borrowed_raw->Z3_inc_ref, {Bool,Float,BV,Ast}::wrap, Z3_get_sort, Z3_simplify), libVEX (vex_lift), or PyO3/CPython (raw py-ctx ptr, CStr::from_ptr) C ABI call that miri aborts on. migration.rs/scheduler.rs unsafe hits are comment-only (unsafe-free designs). Verdict: miri technically feasible but low-value — not worth a CI gate for one already-#[test]-guarded block.
